verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local MoE inference engine with an OpenAI-compatible server and desktop and mobile apps, so acting as an MCP client is a plausible capability. However, nothing in the evidence mentions MCP, tool calling, or connecting external tool servers. The documented features cover expert offload, routing prediction, LoRA adapters, and serving, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
